name: Kalstore(R)
northStar: Paper atelier on a quiet morning. The interface is warm off-white, sparsely set, and lets one mustard accent and oversized editorial type do the talking.
summary: Explore Kalstore(R)'s light E-commerce design system: Paper White #faf9f7, Ink #242424 colors, ABCDiatype, Arial typography, and DESIGN.md for AI agents.

colors.name: Paper White
colors.role: Page canvas - warm off-white that mimics uncoated paper stock; the default surface behind everything

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Primary text, icon strokes, and dominant border color. Slightly softened from pure black to sit comfortably on the warm canvas

colors.name: Felt Gray
colors.role: Hairline dividers, card borders, list separators - the structural neutral that holds the layout together without drawing attention

colors.name: Linen
colors.role: Subtle surface elevation for nav backgrounds and hover states; slightly cooler than Paper White to create depth without contrast

colors.name: Parchment
colors.role: Warm-toned surface for body sections and secondary cards; introduces a faint paper-fiber warmth against the cooler Linen

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Muted secondary text and subdued borders for de-emphasized content like timestamps and helper labels

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Tertiary text and disabled-state borders; sits between Slate and Felt Gray in the neutral ladder

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Navigation borders and medium-emphasis UI structure; a bridge between the near-black Ink and the mid-grays

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Badge fills, icon backgrounds, and the highest surface elevation - used sparingly to lift elements above Linen and Parchment

colors.name: Mustard
colors.role: Primary action color - CTA buttons, nav accents, and badge highlights. A warm sunlit yellow that reads as a sticky-note moment against the monochrome layout

colors.name: Espresso
colors.role: Dark accent paired with Mustard on badges and nav - provides a near-black complement that makes the yellow pop without using pure black

colors.name: Terracotta
colors.role: Editorial accent - appears in the typographic art palette and decorative product imagery. Rust-orange warmth that belongs in illustrations, not buttons

colors.name: Sage
colors.role: Editorial accent - a muted forest green used in the typographic art palette. Decorative, not functional

colors.name: Cobalt
colors.role: Editorial accent - deep ultramarine from the typographic art palette. The strongest chromatic statement in the decorative system

colors.name: Rust
colors.role: Editorial accent - dark brick red from the typographic art palette, echoing the warmth of Terracotta but grounded

colors.name: Sky Dust
colors.role: Editorial accent - a washed, chalky blue used in the typographic art palette. The lightest chromatic in the decorative system

fonts.name: ABCDiatype
fonts.role: The only typeface. A neo-grotesque editorial sans used at every register - 19px body copy, 25px section headings, and dramatic 71-140px display treatments with tight tracking. The wide weight range (400-500) keeps the system monovariational; hierarchy comes from size, not weight contrast.

fonts.name: Arial
fonts.role: Arial - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

components.name: Primary CTA Button (Mustard)
components.role: Filled action button for purchases, subscriptions, and key conversions

components.name: Product Card
components.role: Individual product display in grids and featured sections

components.name: Typographic Art Block
components.role: Full-bleed decorative section using stacked chromatic letterforms

components.name: Newsletter Popup
components.role: Email capture overlay triggered after page interaction

components.name: Sticky Navigation Bar
components.role: Top-level site navigation that persists on scroll

components.name: Price Display
components.role: Product pricing with optional original/sale price strikethrough

components.name: Hero Lifestyle Image
components.role: Full-bleed editorial photography in the primary hero section

components.name: Sale Banner Section
components.role: Promotional call-to-action band with headline and CTA

components.name: Product Detail Card (Calendar)
components.role: Featured product showcase with large image and metadata

components.name: Email Input Field
components.role: Single-line text input for newsletter and form capture

dos: Use #f1ba35 Mustard exclusively for filled action buttons - it is the only chromatic that functions as a CTA in this system.
Set display type at 71-140px ABCDiatype with -0.04em to -0.02em letter-spacing for editorial impact; the tight tracking is what makes the oversized type feel intentional rather than bloated.
Use 8px border-radius for cards, buttons, and inputs; reserve 4px for badges and icon containers.
Use 1px #d3d3d3 Felt Gray borders for structural definition; avoid using box-shadow as the primary separator.
Set body text at 19px ABCDiatype weight 400 with 1.30 line-height - the 19px body size is larger than typical e-commerce (usually 14-16px) and signals editorial intent.

Use the chromatic accent palette (#d26c46, #458e71, #3b59a3, #6c3c3c, #90abc8) only in editorial art blocks and illustrations - never in functional UI elements like buttons, links, or status indicators.
Maintain 64px minimum section gaps to preserve the spacious, magazine-like reading rhythm.
donts: Don't use chromatic colors for functional UI - no green for success, no red for error, no blue for info. The system is monochrome with one warm accent.
Don't apply box-shadows with opacity above 10% - the elevation philosophy is paper-lift, not digital pop.
Don't use bold weights (600+) - the system maxes out at weight 500; hierarchy comes from size, not weight contrast.
Don't use pure black (#000000) for text or backgrounds - use #242424 Ink to maintain warmth on the paper-tone canvas.
Don't add gradients - the raw data shows zero gradient usage; the system is entirely flat surfaces.
Don't use button padding larger than 8px vertical - the compact 6x8px button size is a signature; larger padding would break the restrained feel.
Don't place Mustard (#f1ba35) on large filled surfaces - it works as a button fill or badge, not as a section background.

imagery: Editorial lifestyle photography dominates: warm-toned interior scenes with people interacting with paper products (calendars, notebooks) in domestic settings. Lighting is natural and soft, color palette is warm and slightly desaturated. Images are full-bleed in hero sections and contained with 8px radius in product cards. A single large-scale typographic art block (the ALESAL pattern) serves as a decorative interlude, using stacked chromatic letterforms in a grid pattern on a dark ground. No product-only white-background shots - everything is contextualized in lived-in spaces.
layout: Max-width ~1200px centered content, but hero and art sections break to full-bleed. Hero is a split: large lifestyle image left (60%), typographic art block right (40%). Below the fold, the layout alternates between contained product grids and full-bleed editorial sections. Product cards sit in a 2-column layout in the visible screenshots, with generous 64px section gaps. Navigation is a sticky top bar. The page reads top-to-bottom as a magazine spread: hero image art block product feature sale banner continuation.
